failure.finding: The frozen 428-pixel warm-color predicate removes the bright/medium MARLOWE glyph raster but leaves darker antialiased glyph pixels outside the authorized mask. In the exact Drive-readback challenger those residual pixels remain visibly legible as a ghost MARLOWE word at the incumbent header location.
failure.construction_preflight_reconciliation: The mechanical preflight correctly proved that the implementation changed only the frozen 428-pixel mask and translated destinations. The later pre-score visual audit revealed that the frozen mask itself was incomplete; this does not invalidate the pixel audit, but it invalidates the challenger for subjective design scoring.
failure.reason_repair_is_forbidden: Method 01 freezes the pixel predicate and permits repair only by conforming implementation to that algorithm. TECH-01 already conforms; removing the residual would require changing the frozen mask predicate.

scoring_disposition.note: The comparison stopped on construction integrity before any of the nine integration criteria received a pass/fail score.
